newsitem.title: UK: RUGBY UNION - PUMAS THRASH WEAKENED MIDLANDS.
newsitem.headline: RUGBY UNION - PUMAS THRASH WEAKENED MIDLANDS.

text.p: Argentina piled up 14 tries as they thrashed a below-strength Midlands side 90-24 on Wednesday to record a third successive win on their English tour.
Centre Eduardo Simone scored four tries for the Pumas with full-back Diego Giannantonio scoring a hat-trick. Fly-half Gonzalo Quesada added 10 conversions.
The divisional team, devoid of players from leading clubs Leicester and Northampton, offered spirited resistance but had no real answer to the power and speed of the Argentine pack.

But the Pumas, who face England at Twickenham next month, will be concerned over the number of penalties they conceded, particularly in the second half when they were marched back repeatedly by Italian referee Giovanni Morandin.
